pages.title: File:Kopanie rowów przeciwczołgowych w Oświęcimiu; MŻ 74.jpg

ObjectName.value: Kopanie rowów przeciwczołgowych w Oświęcimiu; MŻ 74

Categories.value: PD-author|Oświęcim|Files with no machine-readable author|Małopolska's Virtual Museums|Oświęcim Jewish museum and synagogue|Artworks without Wikidata item|Artworks with known accession number|Images with extracted images|Children of Poland in World War II|Jewish children in World War II|Media contributed by the Auschwitz Jewish Centre

ImageDescription.value: The photographs show the inhabitants of Oświęcim - both Christians and Jews - digging ditches, probably anti-aircraft. The donor mentions that these were anti-tank ditches, but the analysis of the photographs does not confirm such a thesis. The event took place at the turn of July and August 1939. The photos were made available in 1985 in the Archives of the Auschwitz-Birkenau Museum in Oświęcim by Stanisław Neumann, an inhabitant of Oświęcim. (Description: Artur Szyndler, CC BY-SA 4.0)
